optimizedDescription.value: Translates PHP source (.php) into code-graph symbols, namespaces, Composer PSR-4 imports, framework loaders, and class/trait hierarchy.

optimizedContext.value:
# php-language-adapter

## Rules

### Scope & Analysis
- Handles `.php` as `php`.
- Single-pass parsing via Tree-sitter/ast-grep; outputs `FileAnalysisDraft` without AST retention or PHP execution/autoloading.

### Declarations & Owners
- Extracts functions, classes, interfaces, traits, enums, methods, properties, top-level constants. Drops class constants & enum cases.
- Complete construct range; declared-name `selectionRange`. Preserves comments.
- Declaring owner = namespace-qualified class/interface/trait. Same-name methods distinct across owners. Case-preserving identities.

### Namespaces, Use & Composer
- Namespace `use X as Y` creates namespace-scoped local binding (NO public export or hierarchy edge).
- Resolves qualified names through Composer `composer.json` `name` & PSR-4 mappings via longest prefix.
- Drops variable/concatenated `require`/`include` unless proven by registered rules.

### Framework Loaders & Scoped Facts
- Statically recognizes framework patterns (CakePHP, CodeIgniter, Yii, Laravel, Symfony, Zend).
- Loader facts emit `IMPORTS` and receiver bindings only for literal values with proven indexed targets. Method-local instance aliases emit `CALLS` (no cross-method leakage).
- Emits facts for `new`, ``, `self`, `static`, `parent` receivers, typed params/returns/properties. Emits `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` when target is proven.
- Drops reflection, variable class names, dynamic properties, container lookups.

### Hierarchy & Evidence
- Emits `EXTENDS` (class/interface), `IMPLEMENTS` (class->interface), `OVERRIDES` (matching method replacement), trait composition.
- Reference facts retain child owner, ancestor/trait owner, relation kind, provenance steps.
- Trait conflict/adaptation (`insteadof`/aliases) unsupported -> remains `ambiguous` or `unresolved`. Bounded cycle termination.
- Advertises `hierarchy: true`, `buildContext: false`.

## Constraints
- NO PHP execution, framework container instantiation, or autoloader invocation.
- Dynamic reflection, dynamic container lookups -> prohibited.
- PHP-specific namespace/loader/trait logic MUST stay inside adapter.
